audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers despite the kit giving Azir E 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 and R 120/105/90; two Do/Don't bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted verbatim.
audit.why: Azir E (Shifting Sands) is his shield-dash escape and its 22s rank-1 cooldown defines Talon's all-in window; Azir R Emperor's Divide (120s) is the only peel vs Shadow Assault (100/80/60s).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now states 22s E and 120s R vs Talon 100s R; bullets rewritten to match their titles.

audit.why: Talon R phasing through Emperor's Divide and Shurima Shuffle already covered in spikes[1]; kit-verifiable parts consistent.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Assassin's Path has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — a 22s cooldown at rank 1 (16s max). Once the shield-dash is burnt he has no escape for 20 seconds: that is your all-in. - His R Emperor's Divide runs 120s; when it's down post-6 nothing peels your Shadow Assault (100s).

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: When he steps up to place a soldier, W him, Q the gap, auto the third Wound stack — the bleed keeps ticking while he retreats.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: An uncrashed wave bounces back under his soldiers — you return a plate down while he free-farms.
